notes: Launcher handoff repair on stable v0.2.27. Instead of relying on hiding an already-created PowerShell console, the existing TheFiles.ps1 bootstrap now immediately hands off through wscript.exe to a hidden PowerShell process, then exits. The user's existing shortcut remains unchanged; the hidden process runs the updater and The Files normally. Preserves the bootstrap updater, custom Notes workspace, Timeline, Story, Powers, separate user data, and both runnable/compressed core files. All internal per-file SHA-256 values were recomputed and verified, the compressed core matches the runnable core, and Windows PowerShell parsing passed before publish.
